name: Empresa Metropolitana de Aguas e Energia S.A.
summary: Empresa Metropolitana de Águas e Energia S.A. owns and operates a hydraulic system and electric power generator in the Metropolitan Region of Sao Paulo. Its system includes reservoirs, channels, plants, and associated structures. The company also supplies raw water to public. Empresa Metropolitana de Águas e Energia S.A. was founded in 1899 and is based in Sao Paulo, Brazil.
